title: Entra ID Directory Audit Log Export
summary: Read-only Entra ID script for directory audit log export.
description: Official OperatorOS ScriptForge seed script that collects directory audit log export data for technician review, reporting, and customer documentation. This script is designed as a read-only audit/reporting baseline.
use_case: Use this script when building a Entra ID health report, onboarding baseline, recurring audit, or escalation packet.

safety.notes: Official OperatorOS read-only audit/reporting seed script. Review tenant scope and permissions before running.

requirements.name: Microsoft Graph PowerShell SDK with Directory.Read.All or equivalent read-only permissions.

examples.title: Run report
examples.description: Runs the read-only audit report with default options.

output.description: PowerShell object output suitable for pipeline export, transcript capture, or manual review.

script_body:
# OperatorOS ScriptForge official read-only audit script
# Category: Entra ID
# Report: Directory Audit Log Export

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

Get-MgAuditLogDirectoryAudit -Top 50 | Select-Object ActivityDateTime,ActivityDisplayName,Result

documentation.readme: Official OperatorOS ScriptForge seed script for Directory Audit Log Export. Validate module connection and tenant scope before running.
